source_note: Values were taken from WebSearch results, not from opened documents. WebFetch is blocked by the session network policy (www.montagegold.com and announcements.asx.com.au failed with ENOTFOUND). The per-turn search budget (200 calls, shared by all agents) ran out before any further searches could be made, so only results already returned earlier in this task are used. Each value has via='search' and page=null. 'quote' is the text exactly as the search result gave it: sometimes page text, sometimes the search tool's own summary wording; none was checked against the page. 'url' is the page the result cited. Where the result listed several pages without tying the statement to one, url_certain=false and 'url' is the likeliest of the listed pages; all listed pages are in search_result_urls. No number was inferred, converted with an assumption or taken from memory. Anything no search result stated is null.
